tickets.title: Wire CapitalLedger metabolism into cognitive homeostasis and scheduling
tickets.objective: Register the capital-as-hunger homeostatic loop and wire it into the live CognitiveCycle so ticks and outcomes update HomeostaticState.budget_pressure at runtime, while resolving single-dimension stress_index dilution.
acceptance_criteria: CapitalLedger balance changes are the only thing that can create or clear a capital.starvation event
budget_pressure derived from CapitalLedger reaches HomeostaticState on every CognitiveCycle tick, not just in standalone tests
the stress_index dilution question is explicitly resolved through asymmetric budget-pressure weighting
an Outcome can credit the ledger through a defined, tested path, not just a manually-called MetabolismEngine.feed()
tickets.go_hold_condition: GO after protected CI passes and PR merges. HOLD for external action, autonomous spend and production capital persistence.

tickets.title: Replace point-update learning with generalization, offline consolidation, and adaptive learning rate
tickets.objective: Close the three gaps identified by direct code inspection as separating 'bookkeeping that updates numbers' from actually learning like a brain: (1) OutcomeAttribution only ever updated the exact edge/source cited by a prediction, with no transfer to structurally similar-but-untested pathways; (2) DreamConsolidationEngine produced narrative priority nudges but never touched a learned weight, confirmed by zero references to rewiring/attribution/edge anywhere in dreaming.py; (3) edge_learn_rate and related constants were fixed literals, never adapted by how volatile or accurate recent prediction error had actually been.
acceptance_criteria: learning on one edge partially transfers to structurally similar edges (same relation, shared endpoint), never to unrelated ones, bounded by similarity_threshold/max_neighbors/transfer_rate and RewiringEngine's own max_edge_delta underneath

offline consolidation replays real recorded Outcomes (never fabricated ones) through the same OutcomeAttribution used while awake, at a reduced rate, prioritized by salience, and restores the original rate afterward

edge_learn_rate is no longer a fixed constant: it rises after a run of volatile prediction error and relaxes toward baseline after a run of accurate predictions, bounded by min/max, and never uses an outcome's own error to set its own update's rate

all three are fully backward compatible: no candidate_edges argument means no generalization; no error history means the base rate; existing callers of attribute() and DreamConsolidationEngine are unaffected
tickets.go_hold_condition: GO for the engine-level implementation: all three mechanisms exist, are unit- and integration-tested (25 new tests), and are proven backward compatible with the full existing suite. HOLD for full production wiring: cycle.py is not touched by this ticket (deliberately, to avoid colliding with concurrent fast-moving work on that file) -- candidate_edges and edges_by_outcome must still be threaded from a live edge store into CognitiveCycle's calls to attribute()/consolidate() for this to run automatically rather than only when explicitly invoked.
